scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function copyDir(s,d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name),dp=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())copyDir(sp,dp);else fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp);}}copyDir('lib','dist/lib');"
